title: Tab5 Touch_ST7123 ghost contacts after a polling pause: code-level review

hardware.reason: No Tab5 attached to this workspace; physical reproduction and soak were not performed.

firmware.target: M5Stack Tab5, ST7121 panel, touch FW version 01

execution.virtual_device: NOT RUN: the local Device Service Tab5 profile is tab5_enabled:false with features.qom and features.device_state false; its catalog warning still states that Tab5 ST7123 touch is a firmware GDB mailbox rather than an I2C chip model, and no PI4IOE5V6408 (0x43) or reset-line model exists, so adv_info, the 0x43 block and the pin state cannot be sampled.

checks.name: M5GFX Touch_ST7123 source review
checks.details: No area/intensity/duration filter; intensity byte discarded; INT pin unused; no register writes or reset.

checks.name: 0.2.28 vs 0.3.0 getTouchRaw comparison
checks.details: Function body identical; only the .cpp to .inl layout changed.

checks.name: M5Unified press-path review
checks.details: First pressed frame enters touch_begin; TOUCH_MIN_UPDATE_MSEC is 4 ms; no debounce.

checks.name: host-side parse reproduction with the reporter's field values
checks.details: Shipped logic returns the two edge points; area+intensity rule returns 0; real tap survives.

checks.name: physical Tab5 reproduction, soak and temperature variation
virtual-device reproduction
single-transaction read and INT-gated read experiments
touch firmware version availability and update path
checks.details: No public information found; requires M5Stack confirmation.

checks.name: upstream comment
checks.details: Posted one English comment at https://github.com/m5stack/M5GFX/issues/418#issuecomment-6904885353; issue left open, no code pushed.

checks.name: protocol §6.6 With Coord clear condition extraction
checks.details: ST7123 TDDI Interface Protocol V01.11 p.18-19: reading the last register of the last supported coordinate clears INT and the With Coord bit.

checks.name: ack address coverage in both read modes (10 touches -> 0x0059)
checks.details: stock: 70 B from 0x0014; single: 74 B from 0x0010; both end at 0x0059.

checks.name: With Coord cleared after a burst on device
checks.details: Author measured adv_info=0x08 after 10/10 bursts in both read modes while INT cleared; conflicts with §6.6c; device-side measurement, not reproduced here.

checks.name: two consecutive ghost frames are separate controller frames
checks.details: Author measured INT high-then-low between frames in 7/7 cases; bytes differed in 5/7; excludes re-serve and torn reads.

checks.name: real-touch raw table near x=0 / x=719
adv_info after 10 s idle
checks.details: Would separate a per-frame status byte from a latch that never clears.

checks.name: upstream follow-up comment
checks.details: Posted one English comment at https://github.com/m5stack/M5GFX/issues/418#issuecomment-6908007729; issue left open, no code pushed.

checks.name: #367 is a three-byte change limited to P4/LCD_RST
checks.details: M5Unified 8530f53 Power_Class.cpp:141-155 vs e9a8e89 Power_Class.inl:556-570: IO_DIR 0x73->0x63, PULL_SEL/PULL_EN 0x04->0x14. PI4IOE driver declares bit=1 output and pull_up needs 0x0D+0x0B. TP_RST (P5), CAM_RST (P6), SPK_EN (P1), RF_PTH (P0) and EXT5V_EN (P2) are unchanged.

checks.name: no other LCD_RST writer on the Tab5 path
checks.details: Touch desc has no reset pin (esp32p4_construct.inl:120-128); panel desc has no pin_rst and Panel_Device::rst_control returns for pin_rst<0; Panel_DSI::init sends SWRESET only when getResetDelayBeforeDpi()!=0, which ST7121 does not override; Touch_ST7123 only reads.

checks.name: adv_info=0x08 vs 0x00 tracks the #367 build
checks.details: Author measured 0x00 on 3600/3600 forced reads with #367 and 0x08 on 3600/3600 without it, co-varying 1:1 with ghost frames; device-side measurement, not reproduced here.

checks.name: runtime 0x43 flip and LCD_RST pulse
checks.details: Would separate a latched-at-init state from a continuous electrical effect; left to the reporter, no Tab5 here.

checks.name: upstream round-5 comment
checks.details: Posted one English comment at https://github.com/m5stack/M5GFX/issues/418#issuecomment-6915706899; issue left open, no code pushed, no repository changed.

checks.name: runtime 0x43 flip keeps the latch and gates frames by the driven level
checks.details: Author measured: rejecting the drive (A2) stops frames in one cycle with adv_info still 0x08; re-driving (A3) restarts them at cycle 1; a fresh driven state (B2) takes 4 cycles and sets 0x08 in the same cycle as the first frame. Device-side measurement, not reproduced here.

checks.name: adv_info 0x08 is not sufficient for frames
checks.details: A2 and B3: 0x08 set, LCD_RST on the pull-up, 0 frames in 60 cycles. Corrects the earlier 'frames need both the latch and the driven pin' reading.

checks.name: 10 ms LCD_RST pulse does not clear with_coord
checks.details: 3 ms after release the touch side answered (FW 01, 0x0009=10) with adv_info still 0x08; 0x00 appeared only ~2 s later, in the window where the display was reset into sleep-in (DCS 0x0A=0x08) and stayed dark. Clearing is confounded with display power-down.

checks.name: one DCS 0x0A read suppresses ghost frames while the pin stays driven
checks.details: Boot C: 100 frames in 50 cycles, then one DCS 0x0A read (0x9C) with P4 still driven, then 0 frames in 60 cycles with adv_info still 0x08. Boots D/E and 8 more: frames never form when the read precedes the latch. Device-side measurement, not reproduced here.

checks.name: M5GFX Tab5 init path issues no DCS read
checks.details: Panel_DSI.cpp:36-75 init_panel writes only via writeParams; Panel_DSI::init sends SWRESET only when getResetDelayBeforeDpi()!=0 (Panel_DSI.cpp:122-141) and Panel_DSI.hpp:91 returns 0, not overridden by Panel_ST7121; Bus_DSI::readParams (Bus_DSI.cpp:80-83) is called by no panel/touch path; the only esp_lcd_panel_io_rx_param users in esp32p4 are the LT8912B bridge (Panel_LT8912B.cpp:566-568).

checks.name: 0x43 block after M5.begin() is identical in the sketch and the firmware
checks.details: Author measured 0x03=0x73, 0x05=0x74, 0x07=0x08, 0x0B=0x04, 0x0D=0x04, 0x0F=0x04 on both sides, with DCS 0x0A=0x9C and adv_info=0x00. Closes the expander-configuration branch; the block is not static (0x05 moves when the amp switches), so a post-begin dump cannot speak for the latch instant.

checks.name: upstream round-6 comment
checks.details: Posted one English comment at https://github.com/m5stack/M5GFX/issues/418#issuecomment-6918168398; issue left open, no code pushed, no repository changed.

checks.name: panel liveness on the LCD_RST pull-up state (author-observed)
checks.details: Author reports a blank screen and 0 presses / 0 frames on the pull-up, and recovery after a restart with the pin driven. One unit, one restart, six taps; no finger-control raw table was taken while the panel was blank.

checks.name: DCS 0x0A as a display-liveness witness
checks.details: 0x0A read 0x9C while the panel was blank, so the power-mode read does not prove visible output; earlier '0x9C means awake' inferences are withdrawn.

notes: Read-only review: no M5GFX/M5Unified change, no push to the upstream repository, no issue close.
Host parse results are not device validation.
The reporter's ghost statistics are quoted as their measurements, not reproduced here.
Round 2 adds the author's INT/frame trace and a protocol §6.6 cross-check; no hardware or virtual-device run here.

Round 5 corrects two earlier statements: the 0x43 expander block does differ between the pinned and develop builds (#367), and the sticky with_coord bit is a symptom of the controller's init state rather than a failed read acknowledgement.

Round 6 corrects two statements: the 10 ms LCD_RST pulse did not clear with_coord (the clear coincided with the display entering sleep-in), and 0x08 is not a second precondition for ghost frames (A2/B3 are counter-cases).
Round 6 reply posted as a single comment; the record is cited by permalink at 933e6e3.

Round 7 withdraws the round-6 frame-gating claim and the '0x9C means awake' inference: the reporter's pull-up rows were a blank, non-reporting panel, so the pull-up zeros (mirror battery/boots, develop, earlier 0/58, bisect good steps) are panel-state-unknown rather than fixes.
Round 7 reply posted as a single comment; no issue close, no upstream push, no change to the reporter's repository.

followups.summary: 作者补充逐帧 INT 电平、两种读取模式的 burst 原始帧与 burst 后 adv_info；结合协议 §6.6 复核后，排除重复供给与跨帧撕裂，修正 with_coord 判据，并把鬼点几何由“同一行”改为“两端钳位”。
报告者用强制读排除 with_coord 门控，把差异二分到 M5Unified#367（24dad4ff）；该 PR 只改三个字节，把 Tab5 的 P4/LCD_RST 从推挽输出改为输入+内部上拉，TP_RST 不变。M5GFX Tab5 路径不控制该引脚，故 M5Unified 扩展器初始化是唯一写入者；adv_info 0x08 与鬼点 1:1 共变，指向上电/复位状态而非解析差异。

报告者做了运行期 0x43 翻转、10 ms LCD_RST 低脉冲和两边 0x43 转储。翻转显示帧由驱动电平连续门控（无需复位），0x08 是与首帧同轮出现的粘滞标记而非前置条件（B3/A2 为反例）；脉冲在 3 ms 后仍未清 0x08，清除与显示进入 sleep-in 同窗，“只有低脉冲能清”属过度归因；一次 DCS 0x0A 读在引脚仍驱动时即可停止 60 轮帧，而 M5GFX 自身不做 DCS 读，说明显示命令路径会改变共享 TDDI 的触摸上报状态；0x43 两边一致，扩展器配置分支关闭，剩余差异是 M5.begin() 之后的活动。
报告者更正上拉态屏幕空白、真实按压 0 次按下 0 帧；据此作废上拉态零帧结果、撤回第六轮帧门控与 0x9C 存活推断，并要求后续运行带画面 + 真手指门禁。
